titles.title: God of Hope (We Trust You, Jesus)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You are our hope, O God of hope
All of our trust is in You
You are our hope, O God of hope
Give us joy in believing

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:

And some trust in horses
But we trust in the name of the Lord our God

verse.name: o1

Let not a wise man boast in his wisdom
Let not a rich man boast in his riches
But I will boast in knowing You
You're gracious and faithful
